outcome: chronic hypoxia tissue in the area of the placental site
cohort: 150 patients aged 18-43 years old delivered by cesarean section due to severe PE
finding: The violation of invasion trophoblast, remodeling of spiral arteries were expressed in early onset PE; the degree of compensation of chronic hypoxia tissue in the area of the placental site was typical for late PE and was absent of an early onset PE.
